basePrompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset: Avlys portfolio technical architecture plate, landscape 3:2 high resolution.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND LAYOUT REFERENCE only: match its detailed layered enterprise architecture presentation, not its HJSN content.
White background, navy headings, slender colored outlines and simple clear service icons. Blue client layer, purple application/services layer, teal data layer, gold operational layer. Left row labels, tidy aligned component cards with one or two brief sublabels, orthogonal connectors with explicit arrowheads. Right external integrations column only when specified. Crisp sans-serif type, comfortable whitespace and readability. This is a technical diagram, not a mock dashboard or ad. No invented technologies, uptime/security claims, metrics or slogans. Use only the supplied architecture. Avoid crossing lines or connecting unrelated nodes. Mark planned items with dashed outlines; actual logical modules solid. Layers represent code responsibilities, NOT separately deployed microservices.

jobs.title: HOSPITAL VOICE AGENT
jobs.flow:
Subtitle "Voice reception & appointment booking".
CLIENT & CHANNEL layer: "Caller" (Hindi · Odia · English) connected bidirectionally to "Telephony adapter" (Exotel / Plivo).
APPLICATION layer full width: "FastAPI voice endpoint" (WAV audio request / response).
VOICE & REASONING layer: three sequential cards: "Sarvam STT" (Audio → transcript), "Groq LLM" (Conversation & tool calls), "Sarvam TTS" (Response → speech). Direction STT → Groq → TTS. FastAPI connects down to STT; TTS returns up to FastAPI via separate right-side connector. Telephony connects to FastAPI.
BOOKING TOOLS layer: "Check availability" (get_available_slots), "Book appointment" (book_appointment). Groq connects down to each tool; both tools connect right to a single external "Google Calendar" (Read slots · create events) card.
CONFIGURATION layer: "Hospital configuration" (Hours · doctors · prompts), "Test endpoint" (Text conversation checks). These are configuration/testing modules, no invented database.
Footer "Logical architecture · Deployment status not asserted". Keep all labels exactly. Omit unnecessary services.

jobs.title: MIKE LEGAL AI
jobs.flow:
Subtitle "Legal document workspace".
CLIENT layer: "Next.js workspace" (Upload · query · review).
APPLICATION layer: "Express API" (Documents · conversion · model requests). Next.js connected bidirectionally to API; Next.js connects right to external "Supabase Auth" (User sessions).
DOCUMENT & AI SERVICES layer: "Document intake" (Source files · metadata), "LibreOffice" (DOC / DOCX → PDF), "Model provider adapter" (Document questions). Express connects each; Document intake to LibreOffice.
DATA & INTEGRATIONS layer: "Supabase Postgres" (Document metadata), "S3-compatible storage" (Source files · converted PDFs), "Model providers" (Pluggable inference APIs). Intake connects Postgres and storage; LibreOffice connects storage; Model adapter connects storage and model providers. Do not draw direct DB-to-model connections.
Footer "Logical architecture · Deployment status not asserted". No Redis, vectors, Kubernetes, dashboards or security promises.

jobs.title: WORKSHOP MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
jobs.flow:
Subtitle "Demo foundation · Production wiring pending".
CLIENT layer: "Next.js portal" (HR · facilitators · employees).
APPLICATION layer: "Fastify API" (Workshop operations) and "Worker scaffold" (Background tasks).
WORKFLOW layer three cards: "Registration" (Capacity limits · FIFO waitlist), "Reminder rules" (T-3 schedule), "Insight drafts" (Human approval gate). API routes to these modules; worker connects Reminder rules.
ADAPTERS & SCHEMA layer four cards: "Mock adapters" (Demo execution), "PostgreSQL schema" (Drizzle · repository pending), "Google Workspace adapters" (Production wiring pending), "Azure OpenAI adapter" (Production wiring pending). Mock is solid; other three cards dashed. Workflow modules connect to Mock; dashed lines to relevant planned adapters.
PRODUCTION REQUIREMENTS layer three dashed small cards "Durable repository", "Google SSO / RBAC", "Long-lived worker wiring".
Footer "APP_MODE=demo · Production mode intentionally refuses to boot". Do NOT imply production storage or integrations are running.

jobs.title: HIREDESK
jobs.flow:
Subtitle "Resume parsing, job matching & application tools".
CLIENT layer "Web client" (Resume upload · match results · apply kit), linked to "Supabase Auth" (Token verification) external box.
APPLICATION layer "FastAPI" (Profiles · matches · applications), connected to client.
PROCESSING layer four logical modules "Resume parsing" (Structured candidate profile), "Job ingestion" (JSearch connector), "Hybrid matching" (Vector + keyword search), "LLM reranking" (Ranked job matches). API connects parsing and matching; matching flows into reranking. Parsing/job ingestion feed data layer.
DATA & QUEUE layer three cards "Postgres + pgvector" (Profiles · jobs · applications), "Redis" (Broker · task results), "Celery worker + beat" (Hourly ingest · embeddings). Worker connects Redis and Postgres and Job ingestion. Matching reads Postgres.
EXTERNAL PROVIDERS right column "JSearch" linked to Job ingestion; "OpenAI-compatible APIs" (Parsing · embeddings · reranking) linked to parsing and reranking.
Footer "Logical architecture · Provider configuration required". No measured success rates or production claims.
